note: Surface checklist for the Akinza surface phase (surface-plan.md step 3). Judged by blind readers against the references (sheet, r01 to r04) plus Nick on rendered pictures; no critic-score ratchet. Measured items come from the surface renders; visual items are pass or fail per view. Surface pictures: untracked/species-construction/akinza/surface/<assembly>/ (front, threequarter, side, back, head, face).

items.title: Strands and broken outline
items.rule: Every coat mass (ears, cheeks, chest, arms, legs, tails) shows fine strands and a soft, broken outline at 1024 px, not a smooth clay edge.

items.title: Pale inner coat
items.rule: The pale inner coat reads clearly lighter than the body coat in the ear cups and as a soft-edged bib on the chest, as in r01 to r04, with no chalky flat patch and no hard edge.

items.title: Flow follows the reference
items.rule: Ear strands radiate from the roots, body and limb strands fall downward, and tail strands run along each tail toward its tip.

items.title: No bald patches or stray strands
items.rule: No bald patch is visible on any coat mass, and no strand crosses an eye, the nose, the mouth or a claw, or pokes through another part.

items.title: Eyes match the reference
items.rule: The eyes read as the reference: large dark iris, catch light, and an even dark outline touching the lid with short fur reaching it and no bare band.

items.title: Fur margin on the silhouette, per region
items.rule: Measured on front, side and back alpha renders (render_surface.py --alpha, clay with --hide-fur, then measure_margin.py), the 95th percentile distance from the furred silhouette to the clay silhouette is at most 0.03 world units (figure height 1.86) for body, limbs and head, and at most 0.05 for ears and tails; the fur softens the outline without changing proportions.
items.history: 2026-10-08: the first limit (0.03 p95 and 0.09 max for the whole figure) was a guess set before measuring. The first measurement gave 0.037 p95 overall, driven by the ears and tails, so the rule was split by region.

items.title: Render budget
items.rule: The full six-view surface set renders in under 20 minutes on the laptop and GPU memory stays under 6.5 GB (CPU rendering counts as zero GPU memory).
